notes_for_editor: One source only. The row's coordinates match the record (34.413611, -84.055). The elevation 1366 has no unit on the page; the record's 416.4 m assumes feet. The note 'Ron FL relocate' is not explained on the page and 'FL' is not defined, so its meaning is open; it may bear on whether the tower was moved, which the story says is unclear. The name is a compiler label (the entry is number 418, above the 1-72 USGS range). The row has no NGS datasheet or GFC number. The NHLR Georgia index and the Forest Lookouts Georgia index, as cached, do not list a New Bethel. The Forest Lookouts index lists a Frosty Mountain tower in Dawson County (Chattahoochee National Forest); it is a different site and is not linked. Nothing about build, staffing, fires or fate was found.
